the isolation, structural determination, and cytotoxic activity evaluation of the new megastigmanes, crotonionoside A-G (1-7), from leaves of C. cascarilloides.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have isolated 13 megastigmanes from Croton plants and that we have found the first example of a megastigmanoside with a 2-β-D-glucopyranosyl substituent.

the structures of the megastigmanes isolated from Croton species are not limited to those of megastigmanol derivatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have shown that megastigmanes can be found in Croton species and that the glycosides of these compounds are not only present in the fruits, but also in the leaves.
